integrity: The known optimum value is treated as prior work. The new claim is the complete equality census and three-orbit classification. A dependency-free exhaustive verifier reconstructs the ambient graph from two equivalent definitions and enumerates every maximal clique before classifying every optimum under the stated symmetry group.
scientific_limitations: Finite classification only for binary length five with one asymmetric error. No claim is made for longer blocklengths, multiple asymmetric errors, list decoding, or probabilistic maximum-likelihood optimality. A 1989 thesis is a residual bibliographic risk because its full text was not available in the inspected material.
title: Complete equality classification of optimal length-five binary single-asymmetric-error codes
